## 🎨 Final Manual Step: Social Preview Image

To complete the setup, add the social preview image:

1. **Go to:** https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/settings
2. **Find:** "Social preview" section
3. **Click:** "Edit" or "Upload an image"
4. **Upload:** `assets/img/og.png` (1200x630px, ~646KB)
5. **Click:** "Save"

This will display a beautiful preview when your repo is shared on social media!
